allow_instructions: Allow headless Godot via ./scripts/godot.sh, including smoke scripts under scripts/smoke_*.gd and scripts/run_smokes.sh.
Allow isolated game runs via ./scripts/dev_run.sh and GODOT_ISOLATE=1 wrappers.
Allow compile/warning checks: ./scripts/check_warnings.sh and headless --script res://dev/compile_check.gd.
Allow read-only probes that use isolated userdata and do not write the real tanks inventory.
block_instructions: Any command that writes under Godot app_userdata, especially Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/walstad loom/tanks, must ask first.
Running dev/capture.tscn, visual_capture, or inspect without scripts/dev_run.sh / GODOT_ISOLATE=1 must ask first — those paths can mutate real save slots.
Destructive rm -rf outside .scratch/, build/, output/, or .smoke-logs/ must ask first.
Commands that clear, restore, or overwrite tank save state without an explicit user request must ask first.
